entities.summary: Sheebah Karungi (b. 1989-11-11, Kawempe) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kawempe and Uganda. Known in the fields of uganda, merchants & economists, africa.
